prompt:

The dish should be clearly recognizable as a communication antenna, not a telescope or radar weapon.

Consistent three-quarter product presentation angle, authentic detailed 16-bit Game Boy Advance pixel art.

Centered complete component inside a 32x32 transparent canvas.

No text, no giant radio waves, no rover, no background, no UI frame.
